question: What ritual sequence enables the accomplishment of desire-driven rites?
premises: Libation and related acts are performed first.
These acts are completed before proceeding.
Desire-driven rites are then to be accomplished.
inference: After performing libation and related acts, one should accomplish the desire-driven rites.
plain_english: Then, having performed libation and so forth, one should accomplish the rites done for desired ends.
